{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness plugin for insert custom prompt","id":"gh:1335237926","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"custom-first-control-prompt","slug":"WM-CODER/custom-first-control-prompt","topics":["deepseek-harness-plugin","deepseek-harness-plugins","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-market","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness plugin for insert custom prompt"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @wm-coders/dsh-custom-first-control-prompt"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Deployment-configured prompt prefix. Ordered system-prompt sections render ahead of the deployment p"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ersona, and configured reference user/assistant exchanges are injected into **every ordinary convers"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ation request** — as real alternating messages prepended on the request path (`llm/stream` intercept"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ion, zero session-log writes). Static content renders byte-identically on every request, preserving "},{"id":"p4s5","text":"og writes). Static content renders byte-identically on every request, preserving prefix-cache reuse."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"After installation, restart the web app (`dsh --profile web` or run `restart-web.ps1` / `restart-web"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"installation, restart the web app (`dsh --profile web` or run `restart-web.ps1` / `restart-web.sh`)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"To uninstall:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> Install / deployment / debugging obstacles and test methods: DEBUG-NOTES.zh.md (in Chinese; web fa"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"il-loud root causes, duplicate-id inserts, API verification chains — all paths scrubbed). One-comman"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"d install: INSTALL.md. Full cross-machine walkthrough: INSTALL-FULL.zh.md (Chinese)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Key | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| `sections` | — | Ordered system-prompt fragments; absent or empty registers nothing. |
| `sections"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"[].name` | required | Entry name; the registry sees `custom-first-control-prompt:<name>`. |
| `secti"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ons[].order` | required | Render position among all sections. Factory convention: harness identity −"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"100, persona 0, tool guidance 100–199; values below 0 prepend ahead of the persona. |
| `sections[]."},{"id":"p14s5","text":"enabled` | `true` | `false` keeps the entry in configuration without registering it. |
| `sections[]"},{"id":"p14s6","text":".text` | required | Static section text; keep it free of volatile values — any change breaks prefix "},{"id":"p14s7","text":"reuse from the first changed token. |
| `history` | — | Ordered `user`/`assistant` reference exchang"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"es injected ahead of every ordinary conversation request; both texts must be non-empty and free of r"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"eserved tags (case-insensitive: `<user>`, `<assistant>`, `<exchange>`, `<custom-history` and all clo"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"sing tags). Absent or empty injects nothing. |
| `includeSubagents` | `false` | `false` skips sessio"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"ns whose header meta marks subagent origin. |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Invalid configuration fails plugin load naming the offending entry: empty text, duplicate section na"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"mes, or a non-finite order. Per-entry section problems (blank/duplicate name, bad order, empty text)"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" and per-pair history problems (empty text, embedded reserved tags) **degrade to skipping that entry"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" with a warning** instead of failing the plugin tree."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Injection mechanism"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The reference exchanges are built once at plugin activation into alternating real `Message` objects "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"(deep-frozen, shared by reference across requests), then prepended onto every ordinary conversation "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"request by an `llm/stream` waterfall listener:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Clone and redispatch**: loop-built requests are deep-frozen and marker-tagged (`markAgentLoopReq"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"uest(deepFreeze(...))`) and never mutated; the listener clones the request, prepends the seed messag"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"es, and redispatches through `ctx.llm.stream`. The clone carries no loop marker, the agent-loop log-"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"reconstruction invariant does not apply to it, and the discarded original is a pure `deriveMessages("},{"id":"p18s5","text":")` projection.
- **Zero log writes**: seed messages live only on the request path — real turn number"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"ing starts at 1 with no collisions, forks are ordinary copies, and compaction cannot shadow the refe"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"rence history (every request re-injects it).
- **Scope filtering**: auxiliary calls (`purpose`-stamp"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"ed, e.g. session-title, compaction) and hand-built requests (no `sessionId`) pass straight through; "},{"id":"p18s9","text":"subagent-origin sessions are skipped by default (`includeSubagents: true` opts in).
- **Panel verifi"},{"id":"p18s10","text":"cation**: not seeing the seed messages in the chat transcript is expected; use the panel's LLM liste"},{"id":"p18s11","text":"ner to inspect the injected real request (Settings → "Custom first control prompt" → LLM listening, "},{"id":"p18s12","text":"or the dock strip above the composer)."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"**Verifying the injection works**: in a fresh session ask a question only the injected history can a"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"nswer (e.g. "repeat our earliest user message") — the model quoting the configured content proves it"},{"id":"p19s3","text":". `session.history` shows no seed messages (a clean log is a feature, not a failure)."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**Panel save semantics**: the panel's config editor writes an **id-targeted override** into the prof"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ile `cordis.patch.yml` (never an insert, so it cannot collide with the bundle layer's row), updating"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" only this plugin's core row (`custom-first-control-prompt`) and **preserving everything else** — ot"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"her entries, comments, and legacy rows. While the profile patch carries no row, the editor shows the"},{"id":"p20s5","text":" composed config (bundle-layer defaults); saving then creates the override."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## System sections"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Each enabled entry registers via `ctx.systemPrompt.section()` at plugin load, so it participates in "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"every assembly exactly like the factory sections: variable interpolation, scope shadowing, and the a"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ssembly waterfall all apply. Static configured text renders identically in every assembly, which is "},{"id":"p22s4","text":"what keeps the request prefix reusable."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"#### What the model sees"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Configured section text renders at its configured order position — by default ahead of the persona —"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" alongside the factory sections from dsh-system-prompt."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"#### What the model sees"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Real alternating messages at the head of every ordinary conversation request — one user message per "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"configured `user` text, one assistant message per configured `assistant` text:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Known limitations and deferred work"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **The chat UI never shows the reference history** — the seeds live only on the request path; neith"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"er alternating messages nor framework rows appear in the conversation UI. Reconstructing model-visib"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"le content requires the session log **plus** the deployment config (the framework exposes no plugin "},{"id":"p29s4","text":"event-type registry and `Session.append` cannot carry an `ignorable` envelope) — a deliberate, decla"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"red deviation from the harness log-reconstruction default.
- **Seed text is model-visible reference "},{"id":"p29s6","text":"material** — treat it as prompt text the model reads, not a trusted channel.
- **No mid-session edit"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"s** — configuration changes take effect for new requests after a web restart; a compliant "edit whil"},{"id":"p29s8","text":"e quiescent" surface-replacement event carrying a source seq reference is deferred."}],"truncated":true}
